scope: First roadmap validation on generated live Mininet traffic
label_policy: Request direction to PLC; replies unscored; truth never a model input
selection: Training-only preprocessing and fitting; validation-only balanced accuracy with FPR penalty; test evaluated once after freeze
limitations: Generated request streams, not industrial application transactions
Full 30/60/90 percent and 300/500/1000/2000 PPS publication matrix remains separate
MTD and deception not validated by this classifier experiment
